# Description

Tasks/Inputs required by Pull/Database Requester:

Every PR must attach the approval from **both** the owner & business owner for
the name & description of the database before being reviewed by the CDP team.

- Its advisable to get these approvals before even raising the PR

- You can attach approval emails in the PR (via screenshots or attachments),
  please don't add any CDP members in those emails.

- If the approvers have github accounts you can @ them in a comment and they can
  complete a pull request approval instead.

- Readme.md section has details to be considered before raising the PR

The Description of PR should include the name of the target database(s)*

Reminder a good description should follow the format: "Contains {domain} data
from {source} used by {audience (can include region/business)} for {purpose}."

***
